design_notes: Use a single accent colour (e.g., #003366) for table headers, pull-quote border, and sidebar title.
Financials table: align numbers right, use hairline rules between rows, bold the revenue row.
Pull-quote: set in a larger serif font, italic, with a left hairline rule in accent colour.
Sidebar: box with a thin border, light background tint (e.g., #f5f5f5), compact prose.
No decorative imagery or icons; maintain newspaper aesthetic throughout.
